visual.general_description: Four color close-up facial photographs, panels A to D, with white bars over the eyes, showing flaky scale and redness in panels A and D and an even-appearing skin surface in panels B and C.
visual.detailed_description: A single row of four color photographs, each with a printed letter (A) to (D) at the upper left and a white rectangular bar over each eye. Panel A shows scattered whitish flaky scale and pink-red skin over the forehead, nose and cheeks; panels B and C show an even-appearing skin surface without visible flaky scale; panel D shows a pinkish-red tone over the cheek and beside the nose. The lower edge of the panels shows different garments (white, dark navy, dark, teal). No printed names, numbers or dates are visible.

panels.general_description: Frontal close-up photograph of a face with scattered whitish flaky scale and pink-red skin tone over the forehead, eyebrow region, nose and cheeks.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A is a color close-up photograph of a face seen from the front and slightly from above, with the printed letter "(A)" at the upper left. A white rectangular bar covers each eye. Dark hair with some gray is visible at the top edge. Scattered small whitish flaky scales are visible on the forehead, between and above the eyebrows, on the nose and on the cheeks, and the surrounding skin has a pink to reddish tone. The lower edge shows a white garment collar. No printed names, numbers or dates are visible.

visual.general_description: Line chart of PGA, IGA, scaling and erythema scores at baseline, Day 2, Month 6 and after Month 6, with the values printed in a table under the plot.
visual.detailed_description: A line chart with a vertical axis titled "Score" with printed ticks from 0 to 4.5 in steps of 0.5 and four categorical time labels at the bottom: Baseline, Day 2, Month 6, After month 6. Four series are drawn with circle markers and are listed in a legend and in a printed data table under the plot: PGA (0-4) in blue, IGA (0-4) in orange, Scaling (0-3) in gray and Erythema (0-3) in yellow. The data table prints PGA 4, 1, 0, 2; IGA 3, 0, 1, 2; Scaling 3, 0, 0, 2; Erythema 2, 1, 1, 2 across the four time labels. In the printed values the PGA and scaling scores fall after baseline and all four series print the same value at the last time label. A line of Thai script is printed under the table as the horizontal axis title.
